description: Creates a self-configuring controller VM on redu.cloud. Auto-discovers your network, Ubuntu image, and flavor. Generates and uploads an SSH keypair if you don't have one. The VM bootstraps itself - no SSH or VPN needed. After ~7 minutes, authorize the fleet (run the authorize.sh one-liner it returns) then call trigger_agent_batch.

github_pat.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (repo + workflow scopes)

repo.description: GitHub repo to run agents on, e.g. 'owner/repo'

worker_count.description: Number of worker VMs to provision (default 3)

name: create_controller
title: Create autocoding agent controller VM
